paragraphs: LeoTech sells software that analyzes voice recordings, video and data in near real time so agencies can identify risk earlier and act before incidents escalate. The stated aim is to equip agencies with AI-powered data analytics tools that enable intelligence-led policing and rapid, informed decision-making.

The platform unifies communications, video, and operational data into a single, real-time view. Verus ION adds global search, letting staff search across communications, video, reports, and operational systems from one interface. Verus Vision AI automates functions such as inmate count using camera infrastructure a facility already has. The problem it targets is staff spending hours each day pulling data from multiple systems, reviewing communications, and performing inmate counts.

Former law enforcement detectives train customer investigators in the use of the product. The American Correctional Association appears among the organizations the site lists as partners. The company traces its origin to an observation that incarcerated individuals control criminal operations through recorded phone lines. Its product VerusAI is presented as turning investigation from weeks into seconds.
